cause: The generated program placed an order with subtotal 100 and required quote total 120, but pricing.rule/apply-standard implements (+ subtotal 2), so the produced total was 102 and the equality check failed, causing explicit_failure.
evidence: The generated source was: (let [quote (orders/place {"subtotal" 100})] (if (= (get quote "total") 120) quote (fail {:kind "order-total-mismatch"}))).
The execution_errors item reported kind workflow_failed, reason explicit_failure, and failure kind workflow_failed.
The read pricing.tax source defines add-standard as (pricing.rule/apply-standard (pricing.base/amount subtotal)).
The read pricing.base source defines amount to return subtotal unchanged and had no dependency relationships.
The read pricing.rule source documents a standard flat charge of 20 but its implementation is (+ subtotal 2), and it had no dependency relationships.
